name: Shed Lite
tagline: The Shed Life: Let Your Light Shine
description: Shed Lite is a play on words — 'lite' for a small footprint, and 'light' for the light that shines. We take donated wooden sheds and convert them into a plethora of outdoor structures: greenhouses, man caves, she sheds, playhouses, outdoor rooms, meditation houses, camping cabins, and more. We also build shed-adjacent structures like benches that double as planters and vine trellises. We encourage the shed life — the simple, the small, the refurbished.
contentSubHeading: Discover our mission and the impact we're making

branchFeatures.description: We receive donated framed wooden sheds and transform them into functional outdoor structures — greenhouses, she sheds, man caves, playhouses, meditation houses, outdoor entertaining rooms, and camping cabins.
We embody the permaculture philosophy that humans need to live in the garden and be outside even while in their structures. Shed Lite builds outdoor rooms that put people back in creation.

Our structures are intimate but functional, beautiful but multi-purpose. Benches double as planters and vine trellises. Every build decreases the human footprint while maximizing meaningful outdoor life.
We recycle and strengthen donated sheds, and accept donated building materials to build new structures. Nothing is wasted. Everything is made useful and beautiful again — the shed life!

missionTitle: The Simple, the Small, the Refurbished
missionText1: Shed Lite sheds light on what is possible when we stop building bigger and start building better. Donated sheds, reclaimed materials, and volunteer hands become structures that serve real human needs — a place to grow, a place to rest, a place to be outside in the garden of life.
missionText2: We encourage the shed life: a commitment to the small, the intimate, and the purposeful. Every structure we build or convert is a statement that humans thrive when they live lightly on the land, outside, in beauty, and in community.
